partial_offset.detail: Partial offset requires at least one selected region

weighted_shell.detail: Weighted Shell opened 6 boundary edge(s) on a watertight source, so the shell is not manufacturable. Reduce voxel_size_mm below 0.12, or use Offset Verts for a topology-preserving jewelry offset.

shell_mesh.detail: Shell Mesh fragmented a watertight source into 25 components. Reduce voxel_size_mm below 0.12, or use Offset Verts for a topology-preserving jewelry offset.

offset_mesh.detail: Offset Mesh -0.2 mm fragmented a watertight source into 63 components. Reduce voxel_size_mm below 0.12, or use Offset Verts for a topology-preserving jewelry offset.
